description: In a PA model in the fixed ambient universe, if an internal formula code has the recognized original-language formula bound \(k\), its auxiliary-occurrence test is zero for every internal auxiliary name.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedSyntaxPrograms.noAux_of_formulaBound
  {M : Type} [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {k : ℕ} {e : M}
  (he : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.FormulaBound k e) (j : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.occursAux.value ![j, e] =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
